metadata.title: doc-converter | Private document and image converter
metadata.description: Convert PDF, DOCX and images on our own servers in the EU

footer.tagline: A secure SaaS converter for documents and images. Server infrastructure is located strictly in the EU.
footer.bottomNote: SSE-KMS encryption • ClamAV antivirus • No data shared with third-party AI

home.title: Private document and image conversion
home.subtitle: Accurate OCR for printed text, DOCX to PDF export and image processing.

eu.title: 100% isolation
eu.text: Files are never sent to third-party AI services. All processing runs on our own hardware in EU data centres.

cleanup.title: Auto-cleanup after 12 h
cleanup.text: Guest session files are guaranteed to be deleted 12 hours after completion. Results are encrypted with SSE-KMS keys.

emailDialog.description: Per security policy §6.2, confirmation codes from two emails are required: the first is sent to your current address, the second to your new one. Total window is 20 minutes.
emailDialog.step1Sent: Code #1 sent to your current email: <bold>{email}</bold>

passwordDialog.codeSent: A 6-digit verification code was sent to <bold>{email}</bold>
passwordDialog.completedDesc: All other sessions have been terminated and your API key has been revoked for security.

storage.title: Results Storage
storage.description: Persistent storage quota for converted documents (6 months retention from completion)

storage.over75Desc: Storage space is running low ({used} of {total}). Consider deleting outdated documents or upgrading to the Max plan (50 GB).

rules.euDesc: All files are encrypted with KMS keys and stored exclusively in EU data centers (Germany/Frankfurt).
rules.retentionDesc: Results of accepted jobs are stored for 6 calendar months from completion (§10.1).
rules.batchDesc: If an accepted job result exceeds the remaining quota, it is saved above the limit (§10.3).

clearDialog.title: Clear all storage?
clearDialog.description: You are about to permanently delete <bold>{count} files</bold> totaling <bold>{size}</bold>. All files will be immediately removed from your quota and physically deleted from S3 within 1 hour (§10.4).

files.title: Saved Results
files.description: Web and API conversion results with individual and batch ZIP downloads
files.emptyDesc: All your web and API conversion results will automatically appear here.
files.downloadSingleTitle: Download ZIP archive of this file (§10.2)

apiKey.title: User API Key
apiKey.description: Key for programmatic conversion access via the X-API-Key header
apiKey.rotateDisabledTitle: Key rotation is disabled while conversions are active (§7)
apiKey.rotateTitle: Rotate key with email code verification
apiKey.activeConversionsDesc: Per §7, creating or rotating an API key is strictly prohibited until current conversions finish.
apiKey.securityWarning: Never share your key with third parties or commit it to client-side repositories.
apiKey.emptyDesc: Per §7, no key exists until manually created. Click the create button above to generate a key for API or Telegram bot integration.
apiKey.rule1: - Key rotation requires a 6-digit email verification code; the old key is deactivated immediately.
apiKey.rule2: - Changing your password automatically revokes the active key to prevent interception.
apiKey.rule3: - Revoking a key does not interrupt API jobs already accepted for processing.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate API Key
rotateDialog.description: Per §7, key rotation requires confirmation via a code sent to your email (<bold>{email}</bold>). Once the new key is generated, the old key will <bold>immediately stop working</bold>.

subscription.title: Plan: {plan}
subscription.description: Subscription management, plan switching, and transparent refunds for unused days
subscription.refundInfoDesc: When canceling a subscription or downgrading immediately, the service automatically calculates the unused days and refunds the amount directly to your Stripe bank card rather than an internal virtual balance.

changeDialog.title: Change Subscription Plan
changeDialog.description: Your current period end date (<bold>{date}</bold>) remains unchanged. The charge or refund is prorated based on remaining days.
changeDialog.proDesc: Batch upload up to 5 files, 15 GB storage, 2-hour retry window
changeDialog.maxDesc: Highest priority, 50 GB quota, 2-hour retry window

cancelDialog.title: Cancel Paid Subscription
cancelDialog.description: Per §11.2, canceling your subscription immediately ends paid features and refunds the unused <bold>{days} days</bold>.
cancelDialog.refundBoxNote: Will be refunded directly to your original card with no fees deducted
cancelDialog.autoRenewHint: If you just want to prevent the next charge, turn off Auto-Renewal — your paid period will remain active until {date}.

recovery.title: Recovery Codes
recovery.description: A set of 10 single-use codes to recover account access if you lose your email
recovery.statusHint: scrypt hashes, securely stored on the server
recovery.savedCount: Saved in set: <bold>{count} of 10 single-use keys</bold>
recovery.oneTimeNote: Per §6.5, codes are shown only once upon generation. Re-displaying values by the server is strictly prohibited.
recovery.howToUseTitle: How to use if email is lost:
recovery.howToUseDesc: On the sign-in screen, choose "No access to email", enter one of these 10 codes, and provide a new address. Each code is single-use and expires after use.
recovery.replaceRuleDesc: Generating a new set immediately revokes all remaining old codes. Be sure to save the new file or printout.

dialog.requestDesc: To generate a set of 10 recovery codes, enter the 6-digit verification code sent to your current email <bold>{email}</bold>.
dialog.warningTitle: Warning: this is the only time these codes will be displayed!
dialog.warningDesc: Save them right now. Once you close this window, you will not be able to view these values again.
dialog.confirmCheckbox: I have securely saved these 10 codes separately from my email

support.title: Support Staff Access
support.description: Control support engineer access to specific files for incident and failure troubleshooting
support.privacyDesc: Service staff <bold>do not have direct access</bold> to your document contents. Access can only be granted via your explicit email code confirmation for specific files for up to 24 hours and can be revoked at any second.
support.emptyDesc: When a support engineer requests access to a failed file for your ticket, the request will appear here.

dialog.title: Grant Access to Engineer
dialog.description: You are allowing engineer <bold>{staffName}</bold> to view the specified files for up to 24 hours. A verification code has been sent to your email (<bold>{email}</bold>).

danger.title: Delete Account
danger.description: Complete termination of service, file deletion, and subscription cancellation
danger.item1: <bold>All saved documents and results:</bold> will be immediately locked and permanently deleted from S3 cloud storage within 1 hour.
danger.item2: <bold>Paid subscription:</bold> terminates immediately. Note: unlike manual subscription cancellation, <bold>no refund is issued for the remaining paid period when deleting an account</bold>.
danger.item3: <bold>Sessions and API key:</bold> all sign-in sessions on all devices are immediately terminated, the API key is revoked, and pending queued jobs are stopped.
danger.item4: <bold>Backups:</bold> purged according to the 30-day encrypted backup retention schedule.

dialog.title: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
dialog.description: This action is irreversible. To confirm, we sent a 6-digit verification code to your email <bold>{email}</bold>.
dialog.codeLabel: Enter the 6-digit code from the email:
dialog.confirmCheckbox: I understand that all files will be deleted and the remaining subscription balance is non-refundable
